PHYSICS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dynamics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dynamics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dynamics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dynamics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Dynamics.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS.

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

8. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electromagnetic induction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electromagnetic induction.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electromagnetic induction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electromagnetic induction.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electromagnetic induction.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.

17. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

18. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Thin lenses? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Thin lenses.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Thin lenses.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Thin lenses.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Thin lenses.

20. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Satellites? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Satellites.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Satellites.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Satellites.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Satellites.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
22. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Transistors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites Page 12 of 49 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL PHYS and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Satellites and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

27. In three clear sentences, explain Dynamics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

28. In three clear sentences, explain Circular motion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Floating and Sinking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
